7.3.3.5.5.3 Operations – Proximity Management
The ASAM SOVD standard[5][14] uses the
proximity_proof
method to ensure, that
certain
operations
are executed only, in case a supervising person (e.g. technician)
is physically present at the vehicle, while an
operation
is executed.
These operations have
DiagnosticSovdOperation.proximityProofRequired
set to
TRUE
.
To realize the
proximity_proof
, the interface
ara::diag::SovdProximity-
Challenge
is provided. The intention of the interface is to provide a
proxim-
ity_challenge
for all clients and all operations. A client itself can validate itself
by knowing the "answer" on the
proximity_challenge
and therefore proof, that
there is a supervising person present.
